title: Skyblue's little cloud
text:
Skip to content
Skyblue A little pony homepage
Meet me Little joys Music Say hello
中文
Welcome to my little cloud
Hello, I'm
Skyblue
Skyblue Mornbreeze
A blue pegasus living in Shanghai.
Here are my drawings, favourite songs,
and a few dreams I am working on.
Stay for a little while
[Skyblue, a blue pegasus surrounded by clouds and blue sky]
Cloudsdale born ☁
So glad you found me ♡
A little more about me below
A little introduction
[A cute chibi illustration of Skyblue]
First, a name
You can call me
Skyblue.
My full name is Skyblue Mornbreeze. My ponysona was born in Cloudsdale; in the human world I live in Shanghai, studying, doing research, and enjoying life as a Brony.
Friends may call me Skyblue, Tianlan, or Xiaolan. Every name belongs to the same pony, who is always happy to meet new friends.
☁ Born in Cloudsdale ⌁ Now in Shanghai ♡ Brony
Collecting little joys
Things close to my heart
A few things
that make me happy.
Off we go [Skyblue spreading their wings]
Travelling with Lyra
I love taking my Lyra Heartstrings plush on trips and taking photos together. There is always another little story to bring home.
Little by little [Skyblue on a pink background]
Drawing, stories & music
I am still learning to draw, write, and make music. There are so many pony ideas in my head that I want to share.
One big wish [A full-body portrait of Skyblue]
A robot pony of my own
Someday I hope to build a robot pony as wonderful as Sweetiebot.
More places to visit
A few doors left open
A little wander?
Come along.
My map, my gallery, and my pony friends. Pick somewhere you would like to visit.
[Skyblue's cloud cutie mark]

A note from the clouds
Come back
and say hello.
If you are a Brony too, or just feel like talking about art, music, or a wonderfully silly idea, I would love to hear from you.

title: 天蓝晨风的小天地
text:
跳到正文
Skyblue 一匹小马的主页
认识我 喜欢的事 听点音乐 打个招呼
English
欢迎来到我的小天地
你好呀，我是
天蓝晨风
Skyblue Mornbreeze
一匹住在上海的蓝色小天马。
这里收着我的画、喜欢的歌，
还有一些想慢慢实现的小小愿望。
来坐一会儿吧
[天蓝晨风的蓝色飞马形象，站在云朵与蓝天下]
来自云中城 ☁
很高兴你找到这里 ♡
往下翻翻我的小手帐
一张小马名片
[天蓝晨风的可爱 Q 版形象]
先从名字说起
叫我天蓝
就好啦。
我的全名是 Skyblue Mornbreeze，也可以叫我天蓝。自设出生在云中城，现在生活在上海，一边学习和科研，一边做一个快乐的 Brony。
在不同的地方，也许你会听到朋友叫我 Skyblue 或小蓝。名字不一样，都是同一匹喜欢认识新朋友的小马。
☁ 云中城出身 ⌁ 现在在上海 ♡ Brony
收集一点小快乐
最近和一直喜欢的事
把喜欢的事情，
一件件留在这里。
一起出发 [天蓝晨风展开翅膀的插画]
带着天琴心弦去旅行
喜欢带着布偶到处走走、拍拍照片。每一段旅途都能留下新的故事。
慢慢练习 [粉色背景中的天蓝晨风插画]
画画、写故事、做音乐
还在学习，但总想把脑海中的小马世界画出来、写出来、唱出来。
一个大愿望 [天蓝晨风的飞马立绘]
造一匹真正的机器马
希望有一天，能做出像 Sweetiebot 一样厉害的机器小马。
还可以去这些地方
给你留了几扇门
再逛一会儿？
跟我来。
我的地图、画廊，还有小马朋友们。挑一个喜欢的地方看看吧。
[天蓝晨风的云朵可爱标记]
